summary: The portfolio spans fewer than ten repositories, dozens of owners and tens of thousands of lines. Ada Lindqvist holds 54% of lines; blank lines alone account for 21% and are attributed to Ada Lindqvist.

Cross-repository ownership varies materially: code written elsewhere accounts for 80% in billing-service, 78% in web-frontend and 66% in api-gateway. Ownership by noncontributors ranges from 0% in web-frontend to 57% in api-gateway, and ownership methods agree in no repositories.

At 2026 Q2, inactive owners account for 76% and the principal owner holds 54%. Inactivity eased from 78% at 2025 Q3, while principal-owner share rose from 51%; the next blank-line milestone is projected at 2031 Q4. Code half-life is 2 years.

okr.objective: Improve ownership resilience and consistency across the portfolio.

keyResults.text: Reduce principal-owner concentration from the 2026 Q2 baseline of 54.3%, reversing the increase from 51.2% at 2025 Q3.
Lower inactive-owner share from the 2026 Q2 baseline of 76.3%; it has eased from 77.9% at 2025 Q3.
Increase agreement between ownership methods from a baseline of no repositories in agreement.
